-- =============================================================================
-- Model: stg_accounts
-- Grain: One row per customer bank account (account_id)
-- Source: raw.accounts
-- =============================================================================

with source as (
    select
        account_id,
        customer_id,
        account_number,
        account_type,
        currency,
        opening_balance,
        reserved_funds,
        status,
        opened_at,
        created_at
    from "analytics_platform"."raw"."accounts"
)

select
    cast(account_id as varchar(64)) as account_id,
    cast(customer_id as varchar(64)) as customer_id,
    cast(account_number as varchar(64)) as account_number,
    upper(trim(cast(account_type as varchar(32)))) as account_type,
    upper(trim(cast(currency as varchar(3)))) as account_currency,
    cast(opening_balance as numeric(18, 4)) as opening_balance,
    cast(reserved_funds as numeric(18, 4)) as reserved_funds,
    cast(opening_balance - reserved_funds as numeric(18, 4)) as initial_available_balance,
    upper(trim(cast(status as varchar(32)))) as account_status,
    cast(opened_at as timestamptz) as opened_at,
    cast(opened_at as date) as opened_date,
    cast(created_at as timestamptz) as created_at
from source

-- =============================================================================
-- Model: stg_ledger_entries
-- Grain: One row per double-entry general ledger posting line (entry_id)
-- Source: raw.ledger_entries
-- =============================================================================

with source as (
    select
        entry_id,
        journal_id,
        transaction_id,
        account_id,
        account_type_marker,
        gl_account_id,
        entry_type,
        amount,
        currency,
        original_entry_id,
        posting_status,
        posted_at,
        created_at
    from "analytics_platform"."raw"."ledger_entries"
)

select
    cast(entry_id as varchar(64)) as entry_id,
    cast(journal_id as varchar(64)) as journal_id,
    cast(transaction_id as varchar(64)) as transaction_id,
    cast(account_id as varchar(64)) as account_id,
    upper(trim(cast(account_type_marker as varchar(16)))) as account_type_marker,
    cast(gl_account_id as varchar(64)) as gl_account_id,
    upper(trim(cast(entry_type as varchar(16)))) as entry_type,
    cast(amount as numeric(18, 4)) as amount,
    cast(
        case when upper(trim(entry_type)) = 'DEBIT' then amount else 0.0000 end
        as numeric(18, 4)
    ) as debit_amount,
    cast(
        case when upper(trim(entry_type)) = 'CREDIT' then amount else 0.0000 end
        as numeric(18, 4)
    ) as credit_amount,
    cast(
        case when upper(trim(entry_type)) = 'DEBIT' then amount else -amount end
        as numeric(18, 4)
    ) as signed_debit_minus_credit,
    upper(trim(cast(currency as varchar(3)))) as currency,
    cast(original_entry_id as varchar(64)) as original_entry_id,
    upper(trim(cast(posting_status as varchar(32)))) as posting_status,
    cast(posted_at as timestamptz) as posted_at,
    cast(posted_at as date) as posting_date,
    cast(created_at as timestamptz) as created_at
from source

    cast(transaction_amount as numeric(18, 4)) as transaction_amount,
    upper(trim(cast(transaction_currency as varchar(3)))) as transaction_currency,

-- =============================================================================

with calendar_dates as (
    select distinct
        rate_date as date_day
    from "analytics_platform"."analytics"."stg_fx_rates"
)

select
    date_day,
    cast(extract(year from date_day) as integer) as calendar_year,
    cast(extract(quarter from date_day) as integer) as calendar_quarter,
    cast(extract(month from date_day) as integer) as calendar_month,
    to_char(date_day, 'YYYY-MM') as year_month,
    cast(date_trunc('month', date_day) as date) as first_day_of_month,
    cast(extract(day from date_day) as integer) as day_of_month,
    cast(extract(isodow from date_day) as integer) as iso_day_of_week,
    trim(to_char(date_day, 'Day')) as day_name,
    case
        when extract(isodow from date_day) in (6, 7) then true
        else false
    end as is_weekend
from calendar_dates

--      exceed the amount of the original ledger posting they reverse.

    select

        reversed_revenue_amount as reversal_amount,
        gross_collected_revenue as original_amount
    from "analytics_platform"."analytics"."stg_revenue_recognitions"
    where reversed_revenue_amount < 0.0000

    select
        rev.entry_id as record_id,
        'LEDGER_REVERSAL' as violation_type,
        rev.amount as reversal_amount,
        coalesce(orig.amount, -1.0000) as original_amount
    from "analytics_platform"."analytics"."fct_ledger_entries" rev
    left join "analytics_platform"."analytics"."fct_ledger_entries" orig
        on rev.original_entry_id = orig.entry_id
    where rev.original_entry_id is not null
      and (
          orig.entry_id is null
          or rev.amount > orig.amount
          or rev.currency <> orig.currency
      )
)

-- `unique_stg_revenue_recognitions_collection_id` (_staging__models.yml), while
-- raw.revenue_recognitions DDL permits multi-row adjustments. Numeric aggregation
-- is kept strictly separate from deterministic latest-recognition selection below.
recognitions_agg_by_collection as (
    select
        collection_id,
        count(recognition_id) as recognition_count,
        sum(gross_collected_revenue) as gross_collected_revenue,
        sum(reversed_revenue_amount) as reversed_revenue_amount,
        sum(pass_through_cost) as pass_through_cost,
        sum(net_recognized_revenue) as net_recognized_revenue,
        max(recognized_at) as recognized_at
    from "analytics_platform"."analytics"."stg_revenue_recognitions"
    group by collection_id
),

-- Step 1b: Deterministic chronological latest-recognition selection per collection_id
ranked_recognitions_by_collection as (
    select
        collection_id,
        recognition_id as latest_recognition_id_for_collection,
        row_number() over (
            partition by collection_id
            order by
                recognized_at desc,
                recognition_id desc
        ) as recognition_rank_desc
    from "analytics_platform"."analytics"."stg_revenue_recognitions"
),

latest_recognition_by_collection as (
    select
        collection_id,
        latest_recognition_id_for_collection
    from ranked_recognitions_by_collection
    where recognition_rank_desc = 1
),

-- Step 2: Join collection attempts (1:0..1) with pre-aggregated recognitions
collections_with_rev as (
    select
        fc.collection_id,
        fc.assessment_id,
        fc.account_id,
        fc.collection_attempt_number,
        fc.target_amount,
        fc.collected_amount,
        fc.outstanding_amount,
        fc.collection_status,
        fc.failure_reason,
        fc.attempted_at,
        fc.settled_at,
        fc.linked_ledger_entry_id,
        lrc.latest_recognition_id_for_collection as recognition_id,
        coalesce(rr.gross_collected_revenue, 0.0000) as gross_collected_revenue,
        coalesce(rr.reversed_revenue_amount, 0.0000) as reversed_revenue_amount,
        coalesce(rr.pass_through_cost, 0.0000) as pass_through_cost,
        coalesce(rr.net_recognized_revenue, 0.0000) as net_recognized_revenue,
        rr.recognized_at
    from "analytics_platform"."analytics"."stg_fee_collections" fc
    left join recognitions_agg_by_collection rr
        on fc.collection_id = rr.collection_id
    left join latest_recognition_by_collection lrc
        on fc.collection_id = lrc.collection_id
),

-- Step 3: Deterministic chronological latest-record selection per assessment_id
ranked_collection_attempts as (
    select
        assessment_id,
        collection_id as latest_collection_id,
        recognition_id as latest_recognition_id,
        linked_ledger_entry_id,
        collection_status as latest_collection_status,
        failure_reason as latest_failure_reason,
        row_number() over (
            partition by assessment_id
            order by
                attempted_at desc,
                collection_attempt_number desc,
                collection_id desc
        ) as attempt_rank_desc
    from collections_with_rev
),

latest_collection_per_assessment as (
    select
        assessment_id,
        latest_collection_id,
        latest_recognition_id,
        linked_ledger_entry_id,
        latest_collection_status,
        latest_failure_reason
    from ranked_collection_attempts
    where attempt_rank_desc = 1
),

-- Step 4: Pure assessment-level numeric and timestamp roll-up
assessment_collections_agg as (
    select
        assessment_id,
        count(collection_id) as total_collection_attempts,
        count(case when collection_status in ('SETTLED', 'PARTIAL') then 1 end) as successful_collection_attempts,
        count(case when collection_status = 'FAILED' then 1 end) as failed_collection_attempts,
        sum(
            case
                when collection_status in ('SETTLED', 'PARTIAL', 'REVERSED') then collected_amount
                else 0.0000
            end
        ) as total_collected_amount,
        sum(gross_collected_revenue) as total_gross_collected_revenue,
        sum(reversed_revenue_amount) as total_reversed_amount,
        sum(pass_through_cost) as total_pass_through_cost,
        sum(net_recognized_revenue) as total_net_recognized_revenue,
        min(attempted_at) as first_attempted_at,
        max(attempted_at) as last_attempted_at,
        max(settled_at) as settled_at,
        max(recognized_at) as recognized_at
    from collections_with_rev
    group by assessment_id
),

transactions_context as (
    select
        transaction_id,
        customer_id,
        customer_name,
        customer_segment,
        account_number,
        account_type,
        account_currency,
        transaction_type,
        channel,
        transaction_amount,
        transaction_currency,
        transaction_status,
        transaction_date
    from "analytics_platform"."analytics"."int_transactions_enriched"
),

fx_to_eur as (
    select
        rate_date,
        from_currency,
        mid_rate as eur_fx_rate,
        rate_source as eur_fx_rate_source
    from "analytics_platform"."analytics"."stg_fx_rates"
    where to_currency = 'EUR'
)

select
    a.assessment_id,
    a.transaction_id,
    tc.customer_id,
    tc.customer_name,
    tc.customer_segment,
    a.account_id,
    tc.account_number,
    tc.account_type,
    -- Fee type corresponds to the underlying transaction product schedule
    tc.transaction_type as fee_type,
    tc.channel,
    tc.transaction_status,
    -- Fee is assessed and swept in the account/transaction denomination currency
    tc.account_currency as currency,
    -- Original currency measures (NUMERIC(18,4))
    cast(a.gross_assessed_amount as numeric(18, 4)) as gross_assessed_amount,
    cast(a.waived_amount as numeric(18, 4)) as waived_amount,
    a.waiver_reason,
    cast(a.net_collectible_amount as numeric(18, 4)) as net_collectible_amount,
    cast(coalesce(ac.total_collected_amount, 0.0000) as numeric(18, 4)) as collected_amount,
    cast(
        a.net_collectible_amount - coalesce(ac.total_collected_amount, 0.0000)
        as numeric(18, 4)
    ) as outstanding_amount,
    cast(coalesce(ac.total_gross_collected_revenue, 0.0000) as numeric(18, 4)) as gross_collected_revenue,
    cast(coalesce(ac.total_reversed_amount, 0.0000) as numeric(18, 4)) as reversed_amount,
    cast(coalesce(ac.total_pass_through_cost, 0.0000) as numeric(18, 4)) as pass_through_cost,
    cast(coalesce(ac.total_net_recognized_revenue, 0.0000) as numeric(18, 4)) as net_recognized_revenue,
    -- Explicit EUR reporting conversion via stg_fx_rates on assessed_date
    fx.eur_fx_rate,
    fx.eur_fx_rate_source,
    cast(round(a.gross_assessed_amount * fx.eur_fx_rate, 4) as numeric(18, 4)) as gross_assessed_amount_eur,
    cast(round(a.waived_amount * fx.eur_fx_rate, 4) as numeric(18, 4)) as waived_amount_eur,
    cast(round(a.net_collectible_amount * fx.eur_fx_rate, 4) as numeric(18, 4)) as net_collectible_amount_eur,
    cast(
        round(coalesce(ac.total_collected_amount, 0.0000) * fx.eur_fx_rate, 4)
        as numeric(18, 4)
    ) as collected_amount_eur,
    cast(
        round(
            (a.net_collectible_amount - coalesce(ac.total_collected_amount, 0.0000)) * fx.eur_fx_rate,
            4
        )
        as numeric(18, 4)
    ) as outstanding_amount_eur,
    cast(
        round(coalesce(ac.total_gross_collected_revenue, 0.0000) * fx.eur_fx_rate, 4)
        as numeric(18, 4)
    ) as gross_collected_revenue_eur,
    cast(
        round(coalesce(ac.total_reversed_amount, 0.0000) * fx.eur_fx_rate, 4)
        as numeric(18, 4)
    ) as reversed_amount_eur,
    cast(
        round(coalesce(ac.total_pass_through_cost, 0.0000) * fx.eur_fx_rate, 4)
        as numeric(18, 4)
    ) as pass_through_cost_eur,
    cast(
        round(coalesce(ac.total_net_recognized_revenue, 0.0000) * fx.eur_fx_rate, 4)
        as numeric(18, 4)
    ) as net_recognized_revenue_eur,
    -- Collection attempt metadata & chronologically latest attempt attributes
    coalesce(ac.total_collection_attempts, 0) as total_collection_attempts,
    coalesce(ac.successful_collection_attempts, 0) as successful_collection_attempts,
    coalesce(ac.failed_collection_attempts, 0) as failed_collection_attempts,
    lca.latest_collection_id,
    lca.latest_recognition_id,
    lca.linked_ledger_entry_id,
    a.assessment_status,
    coalesce(lca.latest_collection_status, 'UNATTEMPTED') as collection_status,
    lca.latest_failure_reason as failure_reason,
    case
        when a.assessment_status = 'WAIVED_IN_FULL' then 'WAIVED_IN_FULL'
        when coalesce(ac.total_reversed_amount, 0.0000) > 0.0000 then 'REVERSED'
        when coalesce(ac.total_collected_amount, 0.0000) = a.net_collectible_amount
            and a.net_collectible_amount > 0.0000 then 'COLLECTED_IN_FULL'
        when coalesce(ac.total_collected_amount, 0.0000) > 0.0000
            and coalesce(ac.total_collected_amount, 0.0000) < a.net_collectible_amount then 'PARTIALLY_COLLECTED'
        when coalesce(ac.failed_collection_attempts, 0) > 0 then 'COLLECTION_FAILED_ARREARS'
        else 'PENDING_COLLECTION'
    end as lifecycle_status,
    a.assessed_at,
    a.assessed_date,
    cast(date_trunc('month', a.assessed_date) as date) as assessed_month,
    ac.first_attempted_at,
    ac.last_attempted_at,
    ac.settled_at,
    ac.recognized_at
from assessments a
inner join transactions_context tc
    on a.transaction_id = tc.transaction_id
left join assessment_collections_agg ac
    on a.assessment_id = ac.assessment_id
left join latest_collection_per_assessment lca
    on a.assessment_id = lca.assessment_id
left join fx_to_eur fx
    on a.assessed_date = fx.rate_date
    and tc.account_currency = fx.from_currency

-- =============================================================================
-- Singular Test: assert_latest_collection_attributes_consistency
-- Invariant: On fct_fee_assessments, latest_collection_id, latest_recognition_id,
--            collection_status, and failure_reason must exactly match the
--            chronologically latest attempt in fct_fee_collections (ordered by
--            attempted_at DESC, collection_attempt_number DESC, collection_id DESC)
--            and latest recognition in stg_revenue_recognitions (ordered by
--            recognized_at DESC, recognition_id DESC), and settled collections
--            must never carry a non-null failure_reason.
-- =============================================================================

with ranked_recognitions as (
    select
        collection_id,
        recognition_id,
        row_number() over (
            partition by collection_id
            order by
                recognized_at desc,
                recognition_id desc
        ) as rn
    from "analytics_platform"."analytics"."stg_revenue_recognitions"
),

ranked_attempts as (
    select
        fc.assessment_id,
        fc.collection_id,
        rr.recognition_id,
        fc.collection_status,
        fc.failure_reason,
        row_number() over (
            partition by fc.assessment_id
            order by
                fc.attempted_at desc,
                fc.collection_attempt_number desc,
                fc.collection_id desc
        ) as rn
    from "analytics_platform"."analytics"."fct_fee_collections" fc
    left join ranked_recognitions rr
        on fc.collection_id = rr.collection_id
        and rr.rn = 1
),

latest_attempt as (
    select
        assessment_id,
        collection_id as expected_collection_id,
        recognition_id as expected_recognition_id,
        collection_status as expected_status,
        failure_reason as expected_failure_reason
    from ranked_attempts
    where rn = 1
)

-- =============================================================================
-- Singular Test: assert_no_customer_revenue_fanout
-- Invariant: Aggregating fct_customer_revenue by currency must exactly equal
--            aggregating fct_fee_assessments by currency across all measures,
--            and total gross/net revenue across all currencies must match
--            stg_revenue_recognitions without any join fan-out.
-- =============================================================================

with assessment_totals as (
    select
        currency,
        count(assessment_id) as assessment_count,
        sum(gross_assessed_amount) as gross_assessed,
        sum(waived_amount) as waived,
        sum(net_collectible_amount) as net_collectible,
        sum(collected_amount) as collected,
        sum(outstanding_amount) as outstanding,
        sum(net_recognized_revenue) as net_revenue,
        sum(net_recognized_revenue_eur) as net_revenue_eur
    from "analytics_platform"."analytics"."fct_fee_assessments"
    group by currency
),

customer_rev_totals as (
    select
        currency,
        sum(assessment_count) as assessment_count,
        sum(gross_assessed_fee_amount) as gross_assessed,
        sum(waived_fee_amount) as waived,
        sum(net_collectible_fee_amount) as net_collectible,
        sum(collected_fee_amount) as collected,
        sum(outstanding_fee_amount) as outstanding,
        sum(net_recognized_revenue) as net_revenue,
        sum(net_recognized_revenue_eur) as net_revenue_eur
    from "analytics_platform"."analytics"."fct_customer_revenue"
    group by currency
)

select
    coalesce(a.currency, c.currency) as currency,
    a.assessment_count as assessment_cnt,
    c.assessment_count as customer_rev_cnt,
    a.gross_assessed as assessment_gross,
    c.gross_assessed as customer_rev_gross,
    a.net_revenue as assessment_net_rev,
    c.net_revenue as customer_rev_net_rev,
    a.net_revenue_eur as assessment_net_rev_eur,
    c.net_revenue_eur as customer_rev_net_rev_eur
from assessment_totals a
full outer join customer_rev_totals c
    on a.currency = c.currency
where a.currency is null
   or c.currency is null
   or a.assessment_count <> c.assessment_count
   or abs(a.gross_assessed - c.gross_assessed) > 0.0000
   or abs(a.waived - c.waived) > 0.0000
   or abs(a.net_collectible - c.net_collectible) > 0.0000
   or abs(a.collected - c.collected) > 0.0000
   or abs(a.outstanding - c.outstanding) > 0.0000
   or abs(a.net_revenue - c.net_revenue) > 0.0000
   or abs(a.net_revenue_eur - c.net_revenue_eur) > 0.0000
